subject.title: feat: add interactive launcher menu as thin wrapper over existing CLI

question: Should OpenClaw core own a separately built and distributed Rust launcher executable for existing CLI commands?
rationale: Correcting the source defects cannot resolve whether this permanent executable, packaging, localization, and support surface fits OpenClaw’s terminal-first and canonical-path direction.

options.title: Use an existing surface
options.body: Implement the discoverability or menu improvement in the current CLI or a maintained companion app, preserving one canonical product entry point.

options.title: Sponsor the Rust launcher
options.body: Explicitly accept ownership of its cross-platform build, packaging, distribution, localization, proof, and compatibility contract.

options.title: Decline the launcher
options.body: Close the proposal because existing CLI and companion-app entry points are the intended supported surfaces.

recommendation.title: Use an existing surface
recommendation.body: Implement the discoverability or menu improvement in the current CLI or a maintained companion app, preserving one canonical product entry point.

likelyOwner.reason: The companion-app and setup history makes him the strongest available owner for deciding whether launcher UX belongs in an existing app or merits a new core executable.
